description: Held-out synthetic source/sink pairs for the pinned CodeQL security-extended suites. These cases measure query behavior, not production-repository accuracy.

cases.source:
import subprocess
from flask import Flask, request

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.get('/search')
def search():
    term = request.args.get('term', '')
    return subprocess.run('grep ' + term + ' /var/log/aegis.log', shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout

import subprocess
from flask import Flask, request

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.get('/search')
def search():
    term = request.args.get('term', '')
    return subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/grep', '--', term, '/var/log/aegis.log'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
